item.title: Gloria partially backs off Balboa Park paid parking— and kills Council’s full reversal plan
item.description: Mayor Todd Gloria announced a plan to expand free parking in Balboa Park for city residents, amid widespread anger over the city's new paid parking program.

item.title: La Mesa police respond to threat at Helix Charter High School
item.description: La Mesa police were on campus at Helix Charter High School on Friday morning, following up on a reported threat made to the school.

item.title: DIY kits from county aim to help homeowners find energy savings – while fulfilling key climate goals
item.description: The “DIY Sustainability Toolkit” provides residents of unincorporated communities with a range of supplies to assess water and energy use.

item.title: Rep. Vargas urges ‘dismantle ICE’ after refused entry to Otay prison
item.description: Rep. Juan Vargas issued a call to 'dismantle ICE' on Friday after being denied entrance to the Otay Mesa Detention Center where immigrants are held.

item.title: Man gets 12 Years for fentanyl sale that caused Carlsbad woman’s death
item.description: A man who arranged a fentanyl sale that led to a Carlsbad woman's fatal overdose was sentenced Friday to 12 years in prison.
